fields.lecture.name: Jonathan
fields.lecture.openingQuestion: How to choose what the best course of action is when choosing the programming language
fields.recall.pastEvidence: In previous projects, I have acted as a team leader. This means that I have appointed team tasks and delegated when we have questions or problems. I have also contributed to the coding of the projects and picked up where we might have left off or where we needed more help.
fields.recall.recap: When I think of classes, objects, data, and actions in C#. Like in a game a class is the character blueprint, the object is the actual character, the data is what the character has like health, name, level. The actions are the actions the character does.
fields.recall.questions: How can we change the language of a website so that others can read it? - In <html lang= "eng" > add what language you wanna see.
fields.pipelines.notes: There are 3 pipelines that help with the creator mindset. The pipelines are; Important info. , The beginning, and Storytelling.
fields.pipelines.opinion: I agree with the idea that we should wear two hats so that we can use our tools and our creativity. Just like when thinking about building a robot, I know what I want it to look like and do but the I have to make it actually do it.

fields.attention.notes: The idea of the chapter is that Attention matters and how we can capture the attention of the views we are in "control" we can guide them to what we want them to see, feel and do. There is 3 questions that we ask, and time threshold.
fields.attention.opinion: I agree with the chapter because even in other forms of entertainment engagement is important, if you can keep someone you can keep them in your world, and at the end of the day thats how you can make money and grow a community.
fields.attention.application: An attention leak in a previous work is the movie slide show, the visuals were not there. The slides looked boring and bland so if someone was to look at it they would not be captivated and encouraged to stay and navigate the rest of the slides.
fields.attention.question: How can i survey if the visuals are engaging and adpt from it.

fields.accord.purpose:
Game: Sharksweeper
Goal: Find all safe spaces without clicking on a shark
Player Action: Click a tile
Condition: Check whether the tile contains a shark
Visible consequence: A safe tile reveals a number; a shark ends the game.
